figures.caption: Box 1 Figure | Milestones in the history of meta-analysis. The red line shows the number of papers from a Scopus search; the dashed component indicates the expected future trajectory. The milestone publications 12,16,17,19,74,83,86,87,95-100 are chosen on the basis of two main criteria-precedence and influence (for these criteria, we relied heavily on refs 93 and 94).
